shared_api.name: ClockCheckFailureOperands
shared_api.signature: [[noreturn]] void ClockCheckFailureOperands(const char* file, int line, const char* expression, int64_t lhs, int64_t rhs) noexcept
shared_api.implementation_owner: Root provider-af worktree, exact original V8 diagnostics; no Node assertion substitution

macro.after:
#define PI_TRACE_CLOCK_CHECK_OP(op, lhs, rhs) \
  do { \
    const auto pi_trace_clock_lhs = (lhs); \
    const auto pi_trace_clock_rhs = (rhs); \
    static_assert(std::is_integral_v<decltype(pi_trace_clock_lhs)> && \
                  std::is_signed_v<decltype(pi_trace_clock_lhs)> && \
                  sizeof(pi_trace_clock_lhs) <= sizeof(int64_t)); \
    static_assert(std::is_integral_v<decltype(pi_trace_clock_rhs)> && \
                  std::is_signed_v<decltype(pi_trace_clock_rhs)> && \
                  sizeof(pi_trace_clock_rhs) <= sizeof(int64_t)); \
    if (!(pi_trace_clock_lhs op pi_trace_clock_rhs)) [[unlikely]] \
      ::pi_node::tracing::ClockCheckFailureOperands( \
          __FILE__, __LINE__, #lhs " " #op " " #rhs, \
          static_cast<int64_t>(pi_trace_clock_lhs), \
          static_cast<int64_t>(pi_trace_clock_rhs)); \
  } while (0)

semantic_proof: Each original lhs and rhs occurs exactly once in its value-capture initializer. Comparison uses those captured original native operand types; only failure arguments convert to signed int64.
The selected original operands have no side effects or shared reads: they are local scalar values, constants, or fields of the completed local thread_info/timespec native result.
Every macro instantiation includes compile-time signed-integral and width guards, preventing a wider or unsigned platform substitution from silently losing failure values.

Darwin kr/kern_return_t and KERN_SUCCESS are signed native int; Mach thread_info seconds are signed integer_t, and max-minus-system-seconds is int64. The final seconds limit and accumulated seconds are int64.

POSIX CLOCK_MONOTONIC/CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID timespec.tv_sec uses signed native time_t in the intended Linux/Android/Darwin selections; Darwin uses its separate helper. No CHECK_OP clock site is active on Windows.

Four original CHECK_OPs map respectively to ==, <=, >, >. Stringification produces original lhs op rhs expression form; Root chooses debug operand formatting versus release expression-only diagnostics.
No QPC/TSC/timestamp/PID/TID algorithm, diagnostic declaration, controller call order or native allocation owner changed.
